title: Troubleshooting runbook
content:
# Troubleshooting runbook

Start with these commands before escalating.

| Symptom | First commands |
| --- | --- |
| Port is down | show interfaces status ; show interfaces Gi1/0/10 ; show logging \| include Gi1/0/10 |
| Phone gets no voice VLAN | show cdp neighbors detail ; show interfaces Gi1/0/10 switchport |
| Slow network | show interfaces counters errors ; show processes cpu sorted |
| Possible loop | show spanning-tree summary ; show spanning-tree blockedports |
| PoE device has no power | show power inline ; show power inline Gi1/0/10 detail |
| Find where a device is plugged in | show mac address-table address aaaa.bbbb.cccc |
| Client gets no IP address | show ip dhcp snooping ; show ip dhcp snooping binding |

## Common causes

- **Port in err-disabled state**: usually BPDU guard after someone plugged in a small switch. Remove the device, then `shutdown` and `no shutdown` on the port.
- **No DHCP after a change**: the uplink lost `ip dhcp snooping trust`; see [[Security baseline]].
- **Phone not powering**: the stack may be out of PoE budget; check `show power inline`.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with the output of the commands above and the switch's row from [[Switch inventory]].
